title: Reassemble a commercial manual citrus juicer: seat strainer cone and latch collector bowl
instruction: Reassemble the commercial citrus juicer: seat the juice collector bowl into the base collar and rotate it to lock, drop the strainer cone flush inside, swing the press lever through a test stroke, and clear both arms.
context: Food Preparation Workers (SOC 35-2021; 1,024,400 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023) and Fast Food and Counter Workers (SOC 35-3023; 3,546,800 US jobs) operate commercial manual citrus presses (Hamilton Beach 932 style) across restaurants, juice bars, diners, and cocktail stations. Under FDA Food Code §4-602.11(C) and NSF/ANSI 8 sanitation mandates, all food-contact surfaces in continuous room-temperature juice production must be completely disassembled, washed, sanitized, and reassembled at least every 4 hours to prevent rapid bacterial growth and pulp accumulation. During every routine 4-hour cycle, the worker seats the 80 mm stainless collector bowl into the base collar, rotates it clockwise into its locking bayonet detents, nests the perforated strainer cone flush on the internal shelf, and executes a test clearance stroke of the press lever to verify unhindered plunger operation before resuming juicing service.
setup: Station table with a commercial cast citrus press centered at x 22 cm, y 0 cm, with upright spine, sprung press lever at 85 deg rest, and an 80 mm inner diameter receiver collar ring. A stainless juice collector funnel sits at x 22 cm, y -14 cm. A matching stainless strainer cone insert sits at x 32 cm, y -14 cm.
scoring: Score 1.0 when collector bowl is seated in collar (dr <= 20 mm) and bayonet locked (-35 deg <= yaw <= -15 deg), strainer cone nested flush inside (gap <= 20 mm, dz <= 22 mm), press lever stroked past 35 deg and returned to rest (>= 55 deg), both hands cleared >= 25 mm, and held stationary for 1.0 s. Partial: 0.75 cone seated; 0.50 bowl locked; 0.25 bowl placed; 0.0 fail.
reset_notes: Place juicer base at x 0.22 m, y 0.00 m with lever at 85 deg rest. Place collector bowl at x 0.22 m, y -0.14 m. Place strainer cone at x 0.32 m, y -0.14 m.
fidelity: Heavy cast-iron base with rubber suction feet and 80 mm inner diameter receiver collar with internal bayonet detents. Stamped 304 stainless collector bowl (0.045 kg, 80 mm outer) with matching bayonet tabs and annular support shelf (54 mm outer, 36 mm hollow center). Perforated stainless strainer cone (0.035 kg, 48 mm flange) with 52 mm central knob. Sprung press lever (rest at 85 deg). Strict 25 mm hand clearance and 1.0 s hold.
